meta.title: Polinom.io
meta.description: Technology consultancy that decomposes business challenges into strategy, engineering, data, and execution.
hero.h1: Business growth has a closed-form solution.
hero.dek: Polinom.io combines strategy, engineering, data, and execution into a single equation for your business — then solves it. No guesswork, no black boxes: every term is accountable to a result.
hero.equationHtml: P(business) = Strategy·x³ + Engineering·x² + Data·x + Execution
approach.h2: Every business problem decomposes into terms.
approach.p1: Most consultancies sell you one term at a time — a strategy deck, a dev shop, a data team — and leave you to integrate the rest. We build the whole polynomial: the compounding combination of decisions that actually moves revenue, margin, and speed.
approach.p2: We start by defining your variables — the real constraints of your market, stack, and team — then fit coefficients to them: how much weight strategy carries versus engineering versus data, for your business specifically. The result isn't a template. It's a function tuned to you.
approach.cardDegree: // degree of the polynomial = complexity of your business
services.p: Each engagement draws on some or all four terms — weighted to where your business needs the most help.
services.term1Body: Technology roadmaps, build-vs-buy calls, and operating models tied to a P&L, not a slide deck.
services.term2Body: Product builds, platform modernization, and systems architecture designed to outlast the next funding round.
services.term3Body: Pipelines, applied ML, and decision systems that turn your operational data into a compounding asset.
services.term4Body: The constant term — always present. Embedded delivery teams that ship, monitor, and keep the solution correct.
process.p: The same four-step method underlies every engagement, scaled to the size of your equation.
process.step1Body: Stakeholder interviews, systems audit, and market constraints mapped before a single coefficient is set.
process.step2Body: Strategy and architecture weighted to your actual data, team, and timeline — not a generic playbook.
process.step3Body: Embedded engineers and data specialists ship in short, reviewable increments alongside your team.
process.step4Body: Launch, instrument, and iterate — so the curve keeps rising after the engagement ends.
contact.note: Engagements typically begin within two weeks.
